mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and reduces digoxin renal clearance via P-glycoprotein inhibition, increasing digoxin serum concentrations and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor digoxin levels closely; consider reducing digoxin dose by 25-50% when initiating erythromycin; measure digoxin concentration 7-14 days after starting erythromycin.
